preflight: 20-release threshold smoke on this allocation initially aborted before timed radio because the clean-slot feature input was not initialized; the separate retry completed. Both logs are preserved. Neither smoke is used as a comparison arm.
research_question: Does the Confirm57 train-only channel threshold remain radio-noninferior and complete more AI units when calculated after every two-cell release, compared with an always-NeuralRx arm that pays the same feature cost?
comparison_role: One online channel-gate ingredient of the strong baseline. Pinned endpoints, fixed recovery calendar, AI after radio; not the full queue-aware combined baseline or the proposed joint policy.
feature: channel_estimate_power measured after release in both arms; prewarmed at worker startup
analysis: Pair by cell/index/channel seed. Cluster-bootstrap 4,000 resamples of release-level radio difference with fixed analysis seeds 20590001 and 20590002; require lower 95% limit >= -1.0 pp and AI unit gain >= 0.5% in each pair. Gate failures remain failures; do not add seeds or loosen the 130 ms deadline.
interpretation_limits: Synthetic P150/D130 is not production MAC expiry. Observed zero misses or 25 ms sample-bound compliance is not WCET. Pinned routing and AI-after-radio do not validate the joint scheme, AI-before-recovery lease, or the full strong combined baseline. Earlier external TDL-A NeuralRx incompatibility remains unresolved.
